# faiss-zig (`SMC17/faiss-zig`)

> Vector similarity search in pure Zig 0.16: Flat, HNSW, IVFFlat and IVFPQ with L2, inner product and cosine.

## Repository & Docs
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig
- [README](https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig/blob/main/README.md)
- [AI Inference Zig Stack](https://sunlitmoon.online/lab/ai-inference-zig-stack.html)
- [Build](https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig/blob/main/build.zig) & [Flake](https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig/blob/main/flake.nix)
- [Source](https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig/tree/main/src) & [Benchmarks](https://github.com/SMC17/faiss-zig/tree/main/bench)
